# Bundled browser assets

These files are distributed locally so deployed devices do not need a CDN or npm.

- `xterm/lib/xterm.js`, `xterm/css/xterm.css`: `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0, MIT.
- `xterm/lib/addon-fit.js`: `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0, MIT (same xterm project license).
- `lucide/icons/*.svg`: selected icons from `lucide-static` 1.41.0, ISC.

Original packages: https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/xterm/-/xterm-5.5.0.tgz,
https://registry.npmjs.org/@xterm/addon-fit/-/addon-fit-0.10.0.tgz,
https://registry.npmjs.org/lucide-static/-/lucide-static-1.41.0.tgz.
Licenses are included in each directory. No package manager is required at runtime.
